description.value: Backcountry campground on the shore of a glacially-fed lake deep in Garibaldi Provincial Park, reached by a hiking trail from the road-end trailhead; spectacular Coast Mountain scenery but fully hike-in with no services and complete self-sufficiency required.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record has minimal tags (name and tourism=camp_site only) with no contact details. The fetched website is the general Garibaldi Provincial Park page on bcparks.ca, which confirms Cheakamus Lake is one of the park's named backcountry areas but provides no campground-specific amenity details; backcountry self-sufficiency is strongly emphasized throughout. The 'Book camping' button is prominently present on the park page confirming reservations are accepted via the BC Parks reservation system, and a general BC Parks phone number is listed on the contact subpage.
concerns: Website URL resolves to the general Garibaldi Park page rather than a campground-specific page; campground-level amenity details are not available from this source.
No address present in OSM record; campground is backcountry and trail-access only.
Phone number used (1-800-689-9025) is the general BC Parks call centre number, not a campground-specific contact.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Cheakamus Lake Campground is a legitimate BC Parks campground within Garibaldi Provincial Park near Whistler and would be a useful listing for touring cyclists in the Sea to Sky corridor.

wow_evidence: backcountry campground on the shore of a glacially-fed lake deep in Garibaldi Provincial Park… hike-in with no services and complete self-sufficiency required
